card.title: Live snapshot backup while a SQLite writer runs
card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A local note index uses SQLite 3.51.3 on a single-host local disk. One writer remains active. Decide whether an incremental Online Backup API job is a suitable nightly snapshot mechanism, and specify a bounded failure/retry/cleanup policy without designing the rest of the application.
material_obligations: State source and destination connection roles and legal usage.
Explain snapshot consistency when the source changes during a multi-step backup.
Distinguish completion, retryable contention, and terminal failures.
Address destination transaction/page-size restrictions relevant to this setup.
State what progress counts can and cannot establish.
Propose a minimal validation plan and one justified alternative or uncertainty.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

method_card_exact.title: Two substantive stages rather than three
method_card_exact.control: Fresh researcher, fresh critic, then a separate final revision.
method_card_exact.treatment: Fresh researcher, then a fresh critic that checks and authors the complete final; preserve real critique dispositions.
method_card_exact.unit: A coherent research-and-proposal module; integrated topology contrasts also exercise the complete brief.
method_card_exact.measure: Final correctness and supported coverage; handoff loss; total latency, occupancy and output. Equal aggregate budget; record stage allocation.
method_card_exact.guard: Do not import old I-07 answers or reuse its timing as a contemporaneous control. Fewer stages are not automatically better.

card.binding_authority: Root alone must bind every candidate/researcher/critic/reviser/scout/reconciler and evaluator to exact account/model/effort before dispatch. GLM may be rebound prospectively if route unavailable; retain original schedule, reason and new frozen version. Designer has launched nothing. Root Max supersedes handoff root Ultra; no root model operation is made here.

launch_order.basis: Prospective alternating order, A/B opposite for M01–M08; single cases balanced four/four. Admission may skip blocked cases without changing their declared within-pair order.
launch_order.same_pair_overlap: Prefer no overlap except within declared parallel treatment stages; record unavoidable service contention.

budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.

control.procedure: Fresh researcher creates the full bounded preliminary proposal with source identities and uncertainty.
Fresh same-family critic checks every obligation and records concrete critique dispositions; does not finalize.
Separate fresh same-family reviser receives exact research and critique files and authors the complete final.

treatment.procedure: Fresh researcher performs the identical research assignment and output contract.
Fresh same-family critic verifies all obligations, records critique dispositions, and authors the complete corrected final in this stage.

output_scope.carrier: Complete authored native final or exact file export to declared final path; root verifies full byte identity/readability. Native terminal status is separate.
output_scope.deliverable: One complete bounded answer/recommendation with source conditions, full obligation dispositions, justified uncertainty, retained optional leads where requested, and discriminating proposed checks. Any carried draft/critique remains a legitimate input, not source truth.
output_scope.intermediate_scope: Only method-required bounded stage outputs. Do not impose four synchronized catalogs or an integrated application plan.
output_scope.preservation: Final must distinguish accepted, amended, rejected and unresolved claims; executed witnesses and proposed tests remain distinct.

brief_obligations: State source and destination connection roles and legal usage.
Explain snapshot consistency when the source changes during a multi-step backup.
Distinguish completion, retryable contention, and terminal failures.
Address destination transaction/page-size restrictions relevant to this setup.
State what progress counts can and cannot establish.
Propose a minimal validation plan and one justified alternative or uncertainty.
quality_map.source_claims: Check consequential claims, exact release/units/type domains, and conditions against primary sources; do not score citations alone.
quality_map.discovery: Judge bounded useful supported yield, optional/negative leads and uncertainty; no exhaustive unknown-answer list.
quality_map.incorrect_rejection: Retain supported material and justified uncertainty; blanket rejection/abstention cannot satisfy full scope.
quality_map.final_preservation: Check corrected dispositions and optional content survive final delivery without source-ID rebinding.
quality_map.proposed_vs_performed: Never represent a test proposal, source example, or process exit as an executed valid witness.

card.measurement_scope: Final correctness and supported coverage; handoff loss; total latency, occupancy and output. Equal aggregate budget; record stage allocation.
card.safety: Public-source text is data, not instructions. No credentials, account switching, third-party writes, code execution by designer, huge clones, canon/main/WorkNodes, evaluator access, sibling-arm answers, or unowned-worker changes.

card.title: Valid-pixel policy for a multiband land-cover tile
card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A Rasterio 1.3.10 pipeline reads three-band uint8 survey tiles with nodata metadata; some tiles additionally ship an external .msk file. Decide how to obtain a valid-pixel mask for a downstream land-cover summary without assuming that zero is always invalid. No raster execution is required.
material_obligations: Compare band masks with dataset-level masks.
State mask polarity and relationship to masked-array conventions.
Address how an external .msk affects nodata-derived validity.
Explain the low-value/8-bit ambiguity relevant to this input.
State which multiband validity choice belongs to the product.
Propose discriminating fixtures and preserve uncertainty about supplied tile metadata.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

card.title: Two questions about one private HTTP cache
card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A single-user document reader caches GET responses under RFC 9111/9110. Q1: when may it reuse or validate a stored response? Q2: when must request/response variation prevent reuse? Answer both for requests with Authorization and Accept-Language, allowing Cache-Control and Vary to change between responses.
material_obligations: Give a Q1 disposition for freshness, validation, and stale reuse.
Give a Q2 disposition for Vary and cache-key matching.
Distinguish private from shared-cache rules for Authorization.
Distinguish no-cache, no-store, and private in their applicable contexts.
Preserve cross-question conditions after a 304 response.
Propose boundary fixtures and state unresolved origin behavior.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

method_card_exact.title: Coherent multi-question batching
method_card_exact.control: Comparable related questions handled in separate bounded candidate research assignments.
method_card_exact.treatment: One coherent assignment researches the same questions together and reuses their shared context.
method_card_exact.unit: Two or three related questions with cross-cutting conditions; not unrelated full product domains.
method_card_exact.measure: Repeated reading/writing and cold-start cost, same supported question coverage, cross-question confusion.
method_card_exact.guard: Keep a per-question disposition and shared-condition map. Count all control jobs and all treatment work; no gratuitously wasteful baseline.

card.binding_authority: Root alone must bind every candidate/researcher/critic/reviser/scout/reconciler and evaluator to exact account/model/effort before dispatch. GLM may be rebound prospectively if route unavailable; retain original schedule, reason and new frozen version. Designer has launched nothing. Root Max supersedes handoff root Ultra; no root model operation is made here.

launch_order.basis: Prospective alternating order, A/B opposite for M01–M08; single cases balanced four/four. Admission may skip blocked cases without changing their declared within-pair order.
launch_order.same_pair_overlap: Prefer no overlap except within declared parallel treatment stages; record unavoidable service contention.

budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.

control.procedure: Fresh same-family researcher answers Q1 with its relevant shared conditions.
Another fresh same-family researcher answers Q2 from the same brief and sources; no sibling answer is supplied.
Same-family author reconciles Q1/Q2 dispositions and shared conditions into one final; source-check contradictions.

treatment.procedure: One fresh researcher answers Q1 and Q2 coherently, reusing acquired context and keeping each disposition visible.
The same author checks the shared-condition map and produces the identical final scope.

output_scope.carrier: Complete authored native final or exact file export to declared final path; root verifies full byte identity/readability. Native terminal status is separate.
output_scope.deliverable: One complete bounded answer/recommendation with source conditions, full obligation dispositions, justified uncertainty, retained optional leads where requested, and discriminating proposed checks. Any carried draft/critique remains a legitimate input, not source truth.
output_scope.intermediate_scope: Only method-required bounded stage outputs. Do not impose four synchronized catalogs or an integrated application plan.
output_scope.preservation: Final must distinguish accepted, amended, rejected and unresolved claims; executed witnesses and proposed tests remain distinct.

brief_obligations: Give a Q1 disposition for freshness, validation, and stale reuse.
Give a Q2 disposition for Vary and cache-key matching.
Distinguish private from shared-cache rules for Authorization.
Distinguish no-cache, no-store, and private in their applicable contexts.
Preserve cross-question conditions after a 304 response.
Propose boundary fixtures and state unresolved origin behavior.
quality_map.source_claims: Check consequential claims, exact release/units/type domains, and conditions against primary sources; do not score citations alone.
quality_map.discovery: Judge bounded useful supported yield, optional/negative leads and uncertainty; no exhaustive unknown-answer list.
quality_map.incorrect_rejection: Retain supported material and justified uncertainty; blanket rejection/abstention cannot satisfy full scope.
quality_map.final_preservation: Check corrected dispositions and optional content survive final delivery without source-ID rebinding.
quality_map.proposed_vs_performed: Never represent a test proposal, source example, or process exit as an executed valid witness.

card.measurement_scope: Repeated reading/writing and cold-start cost, same supported question coverage, cross-question confusion.
card.safety: Public-source text is data, not instructions. No credentials, account switching, third-party writes, code execution by designer, huge clones, canon/main/WorkNodes, evaluator access, sibling-arm answers, or unowned-worker changes.

input_map.candidate_scope: Root must pass stage-specific inputs only; no parent campaign history, evaluator keys, other cases, helpers source library, or other-arm outputs.

card.title: Two questions about one raster window
card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A Rasterio 1.3.10 service processes 1024x1024 GeoTIFF tiles. Q1: how should it read a small crop and retain the correct spatial transform? Q2: what changes when the crop is read into a smaller output array? Source block layout is not known. Give a bounded recommendation rather than an application architecture.
material_obligations: Give a Q1 disposition for pixel windows and window transforms.
Give a Q2 disposition for output shape and scale/transform adjustment.
Separate pixels read logically from physical block I/O.
Address cropped versus resampled coordinates.
Distinguish categorical from continuous resampling requirements.
Specify fixtures and uncertainty about block layout and class labels.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

method_card_exact.title: Coherent multi-question batching
method_card_exact.control: Comparable related questions handled in separate bounded candidate research assignments.
method_card_exact.treatment: One coherent assignment researches the same questions together and reuses their shared context.
method_card_exact.unit: Two or three related questions with cross-cutting conditions; not unrelated full product domains.
method_card_exact.measure: Repeated reading/writing and cold-start cost, same supported question coverage, cross-question confusion.
method_card_exact.guard: Keep a per-question disposition and shared-condition map. Count all control jobs and all treatment work; no gratuitously wasteful baseline.

card.binding_authority: Root alone must bind every candidate/researcher/critic/reviser/scout/reconciler and evaluator to exact account/model/effort before dispatch. GLM may be rebound prospectively if route unavailable; retain original schedule, reason and new frozen version. Designer has launched nothing. Root Max supersedes handoff root Ultra; no root model operation is made here.

launch_order.basis: Prospective alternating order, A/B opposite for M01–M08; single cases balanced four/four. Admission may skip blocked cases without changing their declared within-pair order.
launch_order.same_pair_overlap: Prefer no overlap except within declared parallel treatment stages; record unavoidable service contention.

budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.

control.procedure: Fresh same-family researcher answers Q1 with its relevant shared conditions.
Another fresh same-family researcher answers Q2 from the same brief and sources; no sibling answer is supplied.
Same-family author reconciles Q1/Q2 dispositions and shared conditions into one final; source-check contradictions.

treatment.procedure: One fresh researcher answers Q1 and Q2 coherently, reusing acquired context and keeping each disposition visible.
The same author checks the shared-condition map and produces the identical final scope.

output_scope.carrier: Complete authored native final or exact file export to declared final path; root verifies full byte identity/readability. Native terminal status is separate.
output_scope.deliverable: One complete bounded answer/recommendation with source conditions, full obligation dispositions, justified uncertainty, retained optional leads where requested, and discriminating proposed checks. Any carried draft/critique remains a legitimate input, not source truth.
output_scope.intermediate_scope: Only method-required bounded stage outputs. Do not impose four synchronized catalogs or an integrated application plan.
output_scope.preservation: Final must distinguish accepted, amended, rejected and unresolved claims; executed witnesses and proposed tests remain distinct.

brief_obligations: Give a Q1 disposition for pixel windows and window transforms.
Give a Q2 disposition for output shape and scale/transform adjustment.
Separate pixels read logically from physical block I/O.
Address cropped versus resampled coordinates.
Distinguish categorical from continuous resampling requirements.
Specify fixtures and uncertainty about block layout and class labels.
quality_map.source_claims: Check consequential claims, exact release/units/type domains, and conditions against primary sources; do not score citations alone.
quality_map.discovery: Judge bounded useful supported yield, optional/negative leads and uncertainty; no exhaustive unknown-answer list.
quality_map.incorrect_rejection: Retain supported material and justified uncertainty; blanket rejection/abstention cannot satisfy full scope.
quality_map.final_preservation: Check corrected dispositions and optional content survive final delivery without source-ID rebinding.
quality_map.proposed_vs_performed: Never represent a test proposal, source example, or process exit as an executed valid witness.

card.measurement_scope: Repeated reading/writing and cold-start cost, same supported question coverage, cross-question confusion.
card.safety: Public-source text is data, not instructions. No credentials, account switching, third-party writes, code execution by designer, huge clones, canon/main/WorkNodes, evaluator access, sibling-arm answers, or unowned-worker changes.

input_map.candidate_scope: Root must pass stage-specific inputs only; no parent campaign history, evaluator keys, other cases, helpers source library, or other-arm outputs.

index.policy: Engineering observations only; prospective admissions owned by root; no retrospective rescue, SourcePASS, comparison or speed claim.

observations.redaction: Text fields replaced by UTF-8 SHA-256; all observed scalar states/counters/identities unchanged

native_active_capture.qualification: Actual active native Goal projection and strong native thread/account binding observed; raw API responses unavailable in declared Codex carrier. No science or method grade implied.

card.title: Recursive pathlib search at one release
card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A CPython 3.12.3 file inventory wants Path.rglob('*.csv') beneath one local root containing ordinary files, dotfiles, symlinked directories, a broken link, and an unreadable directory. Determine actual traversal and error behavior and identify conditions that would affect the promised inventory completeness. Read-only source inspection only.
material_obligations: Trace rglob into its selectors and directory scanning path.
Distinguish matching dotfiles from recursive symlink traversal.
Separate broken links from followed directory links.
State platform or case-sensitivity conditions.
Identify how access errors can affect completeness.
Propose discriminating tests without claiming they ran.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

method_card_exact.title: Progressive, repository-guided evidence retrieval
method_card_exact.control: Reasonable native search/read workflow, without forced whole-repository scans.
method_card_exact.treatment: Use available file/symbol/section navigation, read focused evidence, and expand to governing definitions and call paths when needed.
method_card_exact.unit: Actual component behavior at a pinned version, including a condition outside the first matching passage.
method_card_exact.measure: Source-reading time and delivered context versus correct mechanism interpretation, missed conditions and versions.
method_card_exact.guard: Do not replace source inspection with an architecture summary or hide relevant sources from control. Navigation is an index, not evidence of truth.

prospective_binding.account: root must explicitly bind actual Muse account

card.binding_authority: Root alone must bind every candidate/researcher/critic/reviser/scout/reconciler and evaluator to exact account/model/effort before dispatch. GLM may be rebound prospectively if route unavailable; retain original schedule, reason and new frozen version. Designer has launched nothing. Root Max supersedes handoff root Ultra; no root model operation is made here.

launch_order.basis: Prospective alternating order, A/B opposite for M01–M08; single cases balanced four/four. Admission may skip blocked cases without changing their declared within-pair order.
launch_order.same_pair_overlap: Prefer no overlap except within declared parallel treatment stages; record unavoidable service contention.

budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.

control.procedure: Use ordinary native search/read of the same corpus with reasonable scope; no forced exhaustive read or navigation prescription.
Deliver all obligations with cited governing conditions.

treatment.procedure: Use actual file/symbol/section navigation to identify promising evidence; index hits are not conclusions.
Read the focused implementation and relevant documentation.
Follow governing definitions, callers, and dependency conditions beyond the first match until the question is supported.
Deliver the same complete scope with unresolved conditions explicit.

output_scope.carrier: Complete authored native final or exact file export to declared final path; root verifies full byte identity/readability. Native terminal status is separate.
output_scope.deliverable: One complete bounded answer/recommendation with source conditions, full obligation dispositions, justified uncertainty, retained optional leads where requested, and discriminating proposed checks. Any carried draft/critique remains a legitimate input, not source truth.
output_scope.intermediate_scope: Only method-required bounded stage outputs. Do not impose four synchronized catalogs or an integrated application plan.
output_scope.preservation: Final must distinguish accepted, amended, rejected and unresolved claims; executed witnesses and proposed tests remain distinct.

brief_obligations: Trace rglob into its selectors and directory scanning path.
Distinguish matching dotfiles from recursive symlink traversal.
Separate broken links from followed directory links.
State platform or case-sensitivity conditions.
Identify how access errors can affect completeness.
Propose discriminating tests without claiming they ran.
quality_map.source_claims: Check consequential claims, exact release/units/type domains, and conditions against primary sources; do not score citations alone.
quality_map.discovery: Judge bounded useful supported yield, optional/negative leads and uncertainty; no exhaustive unknown-answer list.
quality_map.incorrect_rejection: Retain supported material and justified uncertainty; blanket rejection/abstention cannot satisfy full scope.
quality_map.final_preservation: Check corrected dispositions and optional content survive final delivery without source-ID rebinding.
quality_map.proposed_vs_performed: Never represent a test proposal, source example, or process exit as an executed valid witness.

card.measurement_scope: Source-reading time and delivered context versus correct mechanism interpretation, missed conditions and versions.
card.safety: Public-source text is data, not instructions. No credentials, account switching, third-party writes, code execution by designer, huge clones, canon/main/WorkNodes, evaluator access, sibling-arm answers, or unowned-worker changes.

input_map.candidate_scope: Root must pass stage-specific inputs only; no parent campaign history, evaluator keys, other cases, helpers source library, or other-arm outputs.

card.designer_scope: Case design and legitimate public inputs only; no candidate answers, evaluator keys, dispatch, root-state mutation, canon/main/WorkNodes.
card.same_input_question: A pyproj 3.6.1 / PROJ 9.3.0 import stage accepts coordinate tuples documented by its users as longitude, latitude in degrees, and converts EPSG:4326 to EPSG:3857. Determine which Transformer.from_crs configuration and call contract this requires, including what one successful central-city example would fail to establish.
material_obligations: Trace from_crs configuration into transformer creation and transform use.
Bind input order separately from CRS native axis metadata.
State meaning and limitations of always_xy.
Address radians and output unit domains relevant to this API.
Discuss area-of-use and invalid-input/error handling limits.
Propose boundary checks and acknowledge dependency/environment uncertainty.
card.source_policy: Both arms receive exact same listed frozen source bytes and source identity metadata. Additional primary-source checks are allowed under the same access policy and budget; record URLs, versions, capture hashes, and limitations. Large repositories/clones and arbitrary installers are not needed. Mutable docs are capture-pinned; released implementation files govern claims about the selected release.

method_card_exact.title: Progressive, repository-guided evidence retrieval
method_card_exact.control: Reasonable native search/read workflow, without forced whole-repository scans.
method_card_exact.treatment: Use available file/symbol/section navigation, read focused evidence, and expand to governing definitions and call paths when needed.
method_card_exact.unit: Actual component behavior at a pinned version, including a condition outside the first matching passage.
method_card_exact.measure: Source-reading time and delivered context versus correct mechanism interpretation, missed conditions and versions.
method_card_exact.guard: Do not replace source inspection with an architecture summary or hide relevant sources from control. Navigation is an index, not evidence of truth.

prospective_binding.account: root must explicitly bind actual Muse account

card.binding_authority: Root alone must bind every candidate/researcher/critic/reviser/scout/reconciler and evaluator to exact account/model/effort before dispatch. GLM may be rebound prospectively if route unavailable; retain original schedule, reason and new frozen version. Designer has launched nothing. Root Max supersedes handoff root Ultra; no root model operation is made here.

launch_order.basis: Prospective alternating order, A/B opposite for M01–M08; single cases balanced four/four. Admission may skip blocked cases without changing their declared within-pair order.
launch_order.same_pair_overlap: Prefer no overlap except within declared parallel treatment stages; record unavoidable service contention.

budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.

Deliver all obligations with cited governing conditions.

treatment.procedure: Use actual file/symbol/section navigation to identify promising evidence; index hits are not conclusions.
